evals.name: fox-autumn-moon-shadowbox
evals.prompt: Tạo rig cáo nhỏ cắt giấy chạy và nhảy qua đồi rừng thu dưới mặt trăng tròn, có đom đóm bay lấp lánh và chim nhỏ bay ngang trời, khung cảnh thoáng rộng ít che khuất.
evals.expected_output: Interactive shadow-box HTML viewer + validated paper-studio-v2 pack (manifest.json with SHA-256, rig.json, SVGs) featuring an articulated fox rig (9+ bones including bushy 3-segment wagging tail and ears), concentric autumn moon, fireflies emitter, back/front forest hills for occlusion, and flapping mini-bird swarm.
assertions: validate_pack.mjs exits with code 0 and status PASS
All SVG parts pass allowlist and SHA-256 checks with zero errors
Rig has >= 8 bones with valid limits and non-degenerate lengths
Scene includes multi-phase or harmonic motions, ambient emitter (fireflies), and 2-bone mini-swarm (birds)
Standalone HTML compiles cleanly and contains zero Math.random() calls

evals.name: whale-moon-dive-shadowbox
evals.prompt: Tạo cảnh cắt giấy shadow-box cá voi lặn sâu xuống biển rồi vọt lên ngắm trăng, có sao băng bay qua, đàn cá nhỏ bơi tung tăng, ít mây trắng để nhìn rõ cảnh.
evals.expected_output: Interactive shadow-box HTML + validated pack with 11-bone whale rig executing 4-phase dive/breach cycle behind front waves, shooting stars, 2-bone fish school with wave jumpers, concentric moon, and slim border.
assertions: validate_pack.mjs exits with code 0 and status PASS
Whale rig has >= 9 bones with circular overlap tail segments
Motion cycle dips whale rootY below front wave waterline and triggers splash/bubbles VFX
Scene contains meteor emitters and fish swarm across back/front wave lanes

evals.name: artisan-biped-character-rig
evals.prompt: Tạo bộ rig nhân vật cắt giấy tỷ lệ 5.3 đầu mặc áo xưởng giấy, có xương cúi eo, khớp tròn chồng mép, 4 dáng tay và IK kéo trực tiếp.
evals.expected_output: Interactive viewer + validated paper-studio-v2 biped pack with symmetric l/r limbs, spine bend bone, 4 hand variants sharing a common grip anchor, and 2-bone IK definitions.
assertions: validate_pack.mjs exits with code 0 and status PASS
Rig defines sides ['l', 'r'], contacts, ground, and ik chains
Every hand variant asset defines the same grip anchor relative to pivot
Zero external image/video APIs or disallowed SVG tags
